lede: The Telluride Film Festival kicks off Friday and will have the valley buzzing through the weekend, so plan accordingly if you need to get anywhere near town. On the government side, Mountain Village's Design Review Board meets Wednesday to weigh in on a conditional-use permit for a temporary tent and food truck at 332 Adams Ranch Road — a small item, but one headed to Town Council — plus an easement encroachment review and an informational update on Pond Plaza.

notable.stake: DRB votes on conditional-use permit heading to Town Council for decision.
